sources.name: Genius
sources.notes: Existing corpus (~1,425 songs). corpus_dir 'genius' is the ONE legacy exception to corpus_dir==corpus_tag (lyricsdb.py:30 CORPUS_TAG='genius-pro'). Fetched via `toolshop lyrics fetch/search` + extractor batch scripts — sources/ adapters never touch it.

sources.name: Serbian Wikisource (narodne pesme)
sources.notes: ~10k+ poem pages under Kategorija:Народне песме tree (R2 §1). MediaWiki API, action=parse&prop=wikitext (NOT prop=extracts). Serial >=1.5 s + descriptive contact UA mandatory (IP-block otherwise, R2 §3). maxlag=5, <=50 titles/req. Scan each page's license template before ingest (§9).

sources.name: English Wikisource (folk songs / ballads / hymns)
sources.notes: Secondary arm, ~300-500 song/hymn pages + collections (R2 §2). Same MediaWiki politeness block as sr. Do NOT chase Child ballads here — Part pages are {{migrate to}} placeholders (R2 §2); Child comes from gutenberg/sacred-texts.

sources.name: Project Gutenberg (PD song collections)
sources.notes: Catalog-first via PG offline catalog (PD data); text via robot/harvest endpoint or mirror ONLY — never scrape /ebooks/ or /files/ pages (IP block, robot_access.html, R2 §4). Strip PG header/footer boilerplate + transcriber notes.

sources.name: Digital Tradition (mudcat mirror)
sources.notes: One-shot download.cfm zip (~7.32 MB, ~7,800 songs). DROP copyright-flagged items at catalog stage — they never reach disk (R2 §6). Charter is not-for-profit → corpus/internal release use; manifest note required (GATE 0 Q4). No per-song-page crawl (Crawl-delay 10, AI-bot UAs hard-blocked).

sources.name: Hymnary.org (pre-1931 hymn texts)
sources.notes: CSV exports (&export=csv) + pre-1931 instance filter — 'Representative Text' may come from a modern hymnal instance; resolve the specific instance's year, emit only <=1930 (R2 §6). Export path unverified — manual verification precedes adapter work (GATE 0 Q3).

sources.name: sacred-texts.com (Child ballads mirror)
sources.notes: Child ballads mirror (neu/eng/child/chtitle.htm index -> per-ballad pages). Static HTML, light scrape >=1.5 s (R2 §6). PD texts only.

sources.name: ccMixter (acappella uploads)
sources.notes: Query API, default lane tags=acappella x lic=by + lic=pd (release-safe); lic=nc/sa opt-in study tiers (R1 §2-3). ~45-60% lyric yield from upload_description_* via header extraction. license_url -> SPDX via LICENSE_URL_MAP. GATE R waived robots-strict per open-API declaration (t.ccmixter.org/about); MLBot remains banned, never spoof.

sources.name: Jamendo
sources.notes: SHIPS INERT — iter_catalog/fetch_lyrics raise EnvGateError while JAMENDO_CLIENT_ID unset (GATE R). When keyed: tracks endpoint include=lyrics + license_ccurl per track, limit<=200 + offset, ~35k req/mo, error code 6 = rate-limit -> backoff (R1 §5).

sources.name: LRCLIB (synced/plain lyrics API)
sources.notes: Keyless lookup API — iter_catalog reads a local seed file of artist/title/album/duration rows; prefer /api/get-cached then /api/get. Capture plainLyrics + syncedLyrics (LRC) + lyricsfile (YAML per-line ms, R3 §4). 200-500 ms spacing, honor 429 Retry-After. Lyric text remains songwriters' copyright -> study-only.

sources.name: PDInfo (public-domain title index)
sources.notes: Title index ONLY — no lyrics exist on the site (R2 §5). ~50 static A-Z/genre/year list pages fetched once, cached under data/. Titles are uncopyrightable facts; each row's PD claim = 'a pre-1930 source exists somewhere' -> meta.pd_claim='unverified'. Feeds wikisource/gutenberg lookups. No fetch_lyrics by contract.

sources.name: Looperman (acapella uploads)
sources.notes: MANUAL ONLY — adapter reads hand-maintained data/toolshop/lyrics/looperman/_catalog.json (title/uploader/date/BPM/key/genre/usage). NO HTTP anywhere: ToS bans scraping AND ML training verbatim (R3 §1). Module must not import requests (enforced by contract test, §7).

sources.name: Voclr.it
sources.notes: Registry row only this wave (GATE R). Public listing metadata exists but content is commercial rips — own Legal page admits 'not a legal licensing marketplace' (R3 §2). No fetch ever.

sources.name: Acapellas4u
sources.notes: Registry row only (GATE R). Same pattern as voclr — account+credit-gated rips of commercial songs (R3 §3). No fetch ever.

sources.notes: Registry row preserves a future audio lane (R3 §6). Royalty-free packs, corpus_tag null (not a lyric corpus).
